Enabling capture_svg processes inline SVG elements when extract_images is on

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle options_handle = htm_conversion_options_from_json("{\"capture_svg\":true,\"extract_images\":true}");
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<p>Below SVG:</p><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"10\" height=\"10\"><rect width=\"10\" height=\"10\" fill=\"red\"/></svg>", options_handle);
    htm_conversion_options_free(options_handle);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
